text:
jonah: Quick heads-up — after landing the kernel-selector tweak on q3_kv64 I see a noticeable latency increase on short chat prompts. can we run a strict parity harness?

maria: sorry to hear that. is this only on the quantized path and which host type (a8g/a10)? any preliminary numbers?

jonah: quantized q3_kv64 on a8g. quick sample from the harness: `p50=24ms p95=160ms p99=480ms` with avg batch size downshifted. KV hit rate looked ~same.

alex: usually these show up when decoding params or tokenizer flags diverge. let's capture exact decoding config and tokenization checksum. also force deterministic batching if possible.

jonah: agreed. my decode params for the run: temperature=0.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=40, max_new_tokens=100, stop=['\n\n']. tokenizer flags: use_fast=true, add_bos=true.

sasha: note: the change swaps in a fused-softmax kernel for sequences <=128; that can change per-token timings. we need apples-to-apples: same model artifact, same tokenizer, same decode args, same request order.

maria: plan: 1) replay harness with locked decode/tokenizer and ordering seed 2) synthetic client to exercise batching heuristics (sequence mix) 3) collect kernel_choice, batch_size_hist, kv_hit, decode_time_per_token, and nvprof traces.

alex: for deterministic batching set batching.max_wait_ms=0 so batches form by size not time. also run cold vs warm KV modes: cold (clear cache between requests) and prewarmed prefix.

jonah: putting together the harness commands. replay (strict):

```
replay-harness --config configs/strict_parity.json --model /models/q3_kv64 --out /tmp/parity_run/ --concurrency 32 --seed 2026
```

configs/strict_parity.json snippet:
```json
{
  "decode_t": 0.0,
  "top_p": 0.95,
  "top_k": 40,
  "max_new_tokens": 100,
  "stop": ["\n\n"],
  "tokenizer_fast": true,
  "add_bos": true,
  "batching_max_wait_ms": 0,
  "batching_max_size": 64,
  "kv_prewarm": "standard_short_chat_v2"
}
```

sasha: for synth stress we should vary seq lengths heavily to trigger kernel routing:

```
synth-client --pattern short:75%,mid:20%,long:5% --rps 500 --seed 2026
```

perf-bot: scheduled nightly trace job: job/shortchat-kernel-smoke (2026-03-17T23:50Z) artifacts -> /artifacts/shortchat/1765439999

maria: please upload the prompt set and I'll run an independent replay. tokenization mismatch is sneaky when add_bos differs.

jonah: prompts uploaded: /datasets/short_chat/parity_prompts_20260317.txt (~140 prompts). I also captured token id checksums during both runs.

alex: great. also capture runtime flag `prefer_kernel` so we can force legacy softmax in a canary. that will prove causality quickly.

jonah: running the strict parity now. collecting counters: kernel_choice, batch_size_histogram, kv_hit_rate, decode_ns_per_token. will paste a quick CSV when done.

sasha: if kernel selector is culprit, kernel_choice distribution will flip and batch sizes may shrink because the fused kernel affects per-token service time and the batching heuristic reacts.

jonah: first-pass numbers: median +15% vs baseline, p95 +50%. batch mode shifted: mode went from ~10 to ~5. kv_hit_rate stable ~0.72. kernel_choice: fused_softmax used ~80% under new patch; baseline used legacy for ~88%.

maria: tokenization SHA256 checks (first 5 prompts):
`p1: baseline=5f3c... new=5f3c... (match)`,
`p2: baseline=a2b1... new=a2b1... (match)`
`p3: baseline=9d7e... new=9d7e... (match)`

alex: sounds causal. next step: run small canary with prefer_kernel=legacy_softmax and re-run strict parity. if latency returns to baseline that's a clear regression from kernel swap.

jonah: scheduling canary on a 4-host pool with prefer_kernel=legacy_softmax. I'll re-run harness afterward and put results in /artifacts/shortchat/1765439999/analysis.csv + nvprof traces.

sasha: for the postmortem we should include: exact config, tokenization checksums, kernel_choice temporal distribution, and a short mitigation (rollback or throttled rollout). also consider adding an automatic fallback: if p95 > slo*1.2 for 3m then prefer legacy.

perf-bot: perf traces uploaded: /traces/1765439999/trace_bundle.tar.gz

maria: running independent replay now. will compare token streams (bytewise) and run sha256 on token ids.

jonah: thanks all. I'll paste the CSV summary + batch hist + kernel distribution when the canary completes. tagging this thread so we have the audit trail. :white_check_mark:
